description: Reg. § 1.453-12(d) Example 3 (§ 1231(c) recapture): Example 1's sale with $1,000 of non-recaptured net § 1231 losses. 1999: 'all of A's $800 installment gain is recaptured as ordinary income under section 1231(c) ... the $800 ... is treated as reducing unrecaptured section 1250 gain ... A has $2200 of unrecaptured section 1250 gain remaining'. Nothing is taxed at 25%; $200 of the lookback remains.
